description.value:
You study a target within range, spotting a weakness in its defenses. You gain advantage on the next attack roll you make against that target before the end of your next turn.

At 5th level you can apply this benefit to your next two attacks against the target, three attacks at 11th level, and four attacks at 17th level.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, At-Will
